note: The Act 1 Normal campaign spine: the order a human plays, as chapters. Every level number is EXP (a veteran's read, docs/sme/pace-and-formulas.md section 1 and the class tables) unless it names plandata; nothing is measured on the bot. floor = the lowest level the bot goes at when the player chooses 'go at the floor'; recommended = the level a careful player has (the default for Auto). A chapter is never locked: the player can always say Go now.

chapters.title: A new hero
chapters.reward: first kills, first potions; the hero learns the road out of camp
chapters.why: Every hero starts in the Blood Moor: easy kills, first level-ups.

chapters.title: Cold Plains waypoint
chapters.reward: the first waypoint: fast travel out of camp
chapters.why: The Cold Plains waypoint saves the long walk on every trip.

chapters.title: Den of Evil
chapters.reward: Akara's free skill point (and a respec later)
chapters.why: Akara gives a free skill point for clearing the Den of Evil.

chapters.title: Blood Raven
chapters.why: Killing Blood Raven earns a free Rogue mercenary from Kashya.

chapters.title: Claim the Rogue
chapters.reward: a Rogue archer fights at the hero's side (revived at Kashya when she falls)
chapters.why: Kashya gives one free Rogue for Blood Raven: claim her before the harder chapters.

chapters.title: Find Deckard Cain
chapters.reward: Cain identifies items for free; Tristram opens as a farm zone
chapters.why: Rescuing Cain in Tristram makes identifying free.

chapters.title: The Countess
chapters.reward: the Countess drops runes and gold (no quest reward in Normal)
chapters.why: The Countess drops the first runes.

chapters.title: Charsi's hammer
chapters.reward: Charsi imbues one item with magic properties
chapters.why: Bringing the Horadric Malus back to Charsi earns a free imbue.

chapters.title: Andariel
chapters.reward: Act 1 done: the road to Lut Gholein and Act 2
chapters.why: Andariel guards the way east; killing her opens Act 2.
